# Job Application Tracker

> An open-source (Apache-2.0), self-hosted, local-first web app for tracking a job search,
> built for software engineers. It tracks applications, recruiters and agencies (one
> recruiter can have many roles), configurable interview stages with timestamped history,
> Markdown notes, attachments and exported emails, CV and cover-letter versions, interviews
> and coding tasks, and a "Next actions" page for stalled applications. It never scrapes job
> boards or contacts anyone, and all data stays in one local directory outside the code.

Status: early development. The PM dashboard (`python3 -m tools.pm`) works; the tracker app is
being built phase by phase.
